item.title: Q99.5 Drops Tejano Format After 12 Years, Flips to Christian AC
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A San Angelo radio station ended its long-running Tejano music format Feb. 1, switching to Christian adult contemporary programming under a new brand, “99.5 Spirit of Truth Radio," according to a report made by TejanoNation. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State Softball to Host George and Ola McCorkle Challenge This Weekend
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The Angelo State softball team is home for the first time in 2026 this weekend when the Rambelles host the George and Ola McCorkle Challenge presented by West Texas Steel.This year’s event holds special significance after Ola McCorkle passed away on Dec. 23, 2025, at the age of 81. Learn More Here.

item.title: WATCH: Angelo State Adds 22 High School Standouts in Signing Class
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The Angelo State University football team announced the addition of 22 high school standouts from around the state Wednesday as part of its 2026 signing class, along with five players through the transfer portal.Among the players signed were two West Texas players — Odessa Permian defensive back Cameron Mattingly and Midland Legacy offensive lineman Dylan Roemisch. Learn More Here.

item.title: Pfluger Presses FERC Chair: Pipeline Shortages Drove Energy Prices Up 300 Times Normal During Winter Storm Fern
item.description: WASHINGTON, DC — Congressman August Pfluger (TX-11) questioned Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Chairman Laura Swett on how to prevent a repeat of several failures witnessed during Winter Storm Fern during a House Energy and Commerce Energy Subcommittee hearing on oversight of the FERC. Learn More Here.

item.title: Central Bobcats' Head Coach Smith Named Region 2-6A Coach of the Year
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Central Bobcats' Head Football Coach Mark Smith added another accolade to place upon an incredibly successful football season this school year as the Texas High School Coaches Association named Smith the 2026 Region 2-6A Coach of the Year on Thursday. Learn More Here.

item.title: Paxton Sues Company for Illegal Dumping of Thousands of Wind Turbine Blades in Sweetwater
item.description: SWEETWATER, TX - Attorney General Ken Paxton sued Global Fiberglass Solutions, Inc. (“Global”) and other affiliated entities for illegally dumping thousands of wind turbine blades and materials at two disposal sites in Sweetwater, Texas. Learn More Here.

item.title: New Details on 70+ Animals Rescued from Alleged Neglect in Ballinger
item.description: BALLINGER, TX - More than 70 dogs and puppies, horses, birds and a cat are receiving much-needed care and treatment following their rescue from a large-scale alleged neglect case in Ballinger, Texas.On Tuesday, Humane World for Animals assisted the Runnels County Sheriff’s Office in the execution of a search and seizure warrant on a residential property. Operation Kindness Humane Society and the Humane Society of Greater Kansas City also assisted in the rescue. Learn More Here.

item.title: San Angelo Scores $1M in Federal Funds for Future I-27 Planning
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — The H.R. 7148, Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, signed on February 3, 2026, delivers $19.24 million in federal funding to advance critical planning, safety, and infrastructure projects across the Ports-to-Plains Alliance corridor, strengthening regional connectivity, freight mobility, and future interstate development. item.title: Victim in Electric Wheelchair Hit in Crash on Chadbourne
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — San Angelo police responded to a major crash on N. Chadbourne Street around 10:45 p.m. Thursday. Upon arrival, officers found an individual who had been ejected from their electric wheelchair and at least one crashed vehicle. By the time San Angelo LIVE! arrived at the scene, emergency medical services had already transported the victim to a hospital. Learn More Here.
